column1: # US Genesis GPGX forced-RAM action timing capture; emulator only.
# Player is record FF0100; Q/I at +0x78/+0x7B, skill at +0x80..+0x8B, cyberware at +0x90.
# Movement pass counts complete GPGX frames after the action-entry frame; right is held after A is released.
# A positive gate_at_first_movement proves movement resumes before the separate next-action gate.
